name: gameye
description: Teach your coding agent to ship multiplayer: skills for authoritative server design, engine server builds, containerization, the Gameye sessions API, matchmaking and launch, plus the bundled Gameye MCP server.

gameye_api_token.title: Gameye API token
gameye_api_token.description: Optional. API token from the Gameye Admin Panel (Users > API Tokens) for the environment below; without one, the Gameye MCP server runs its offline tools (skills, engine templates, Dockerfile check) and account tools return setup steps. Use the narrowest scopes you need. Stored in secure storage, never in settings.json.

gameye_env.title: Gameye environment
gameye_env.description: Valid values: sandbox or production; the MCP server refuses to start with anything else. sandbox is for self-serve customers (their permanent home, live matches run there); production is for enterprise customers onboarded by Gameye. Tokens from one environment do not work on the other.
